name: GAIA JSON Index
description: Complete registry of all JSON files in the GAIA cosmos. Materials, scenes, objects, realms, and altars.

olympian-materials.json.description: Divine palette — marble, gold, bronze, rose quartz, peacock blue, storm grey, obsidian, flames, water, void

altar-objects.json.description: Sacred objects for altars and ritual spaces — offering bowls, braziers, tripods, thunderbolts, tridents, lyres, owl statues, caduceus, mirrors, anvils, bows, laurels, grain sheaves

gwalenn.json.description: The Olympian Haven — 12 altars in a ring, central hearth, Ouranos sky, marble floor

zeus-realm.json.description: Thunder Peak — throne room of Zeus. Storm grey walls, massive throne, eagles, Styx river, lightning, oath-breaker chains

olympus-storm.json.description: Storm Belt — shattered pillars, oath-winds, offering bowl, lightning sky

olympus-pantheon.json.description: Pantheon Ledge — 12 doorways to every god's realm, marble white, golden light

olympus-hall.json.description: Hall of Assembly — council seats, central hearth, torch sconces, the laws of Olympus

olympus-lower.json.description: The Ascent — votive stones, worn pilgrim path, torchlight, exit to Gwalenn
